payload.reason: The evidence indicates that regularization through auxiliary penalty terms during fine-tuning does not harm target domain performance and can even improve it in some cases.

claims.text: Regularization of the fine-tuning process does not harm target performance and can improve it.
Combining auxiliary penalty terms during fine-tuning helps preserve source performance without negatively impacting target performance.
Fine-tuning generally improves target domain performance compared to pre-training alone.
